text:
Moon! Crown of an immense head,

shedding your leaves into golden shadows!

Red crown of a Jesus who thinks

tragically sweet thoughts of emeralds!


Moon! Crazed celestial heart,

why do you sail so, inside a goblet

filled with blue wine, toward the west,

like a defeated, suffering stern?


Moon! And by dint of flying in vain,

you immolate yourself in scattered opals:

perhaps you are my gypsy heart,

wandering the blue, weeping verses!…

translation.title: Sacred Defoliation
translation.editorial_note: The decadent jeweled imagery remains lush; deshojación binds lunar phases to petals, leaves, and sacrificial stripping.
